three.js r170 (npm three@0.170.0), build/three.module.min.js, unmodified.
Copied from apps/games/landcraft/vendor/three/build/three.module.min.js (identical to
apps/media/3d-builder's copy). MIT licence: see LICENSE (Copyright 2010-2024 three.js authors).
Shared by Learn apps that need 3D (first user: driving-school, DS-2a).
Load it as an ES module with a relative path, e.g.
  import * as THREE from '../common/vendor/three/three.module.min.js';
ES modules do not load over file://; apps must keep a non-3D fallback for that case.
